description: Pre-install PowerShell Editor Services on session start

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "powershell-lsp: pwsh (PowerShell 7+) was not found on PATH; install it to enable the PowerShell language server."; exit 0; }; pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ensure-pses.ps1"
